release_notes.title: v1.3.0 — Field-review safety fixes (October 2026)
release_notes.highlights: Fixes from the 2026-10 field screenshots and the 46 h, 15-cycle run: a stale trip banner can no longer idle a running test, glitching thermistors no longer false-trip, voltage faults follow a recover-or-latch policy, and the charts and recipe tab read correctly.

safety: Safety Reset refused while a test runs; step-setup failures latch the interlock like every other trip
Rate-of-rise thermal trip needs both probes to agree (a single glitching probe fitted 4-5 C/min on the 1 Oct run)

Voltage faults: CUV/under-voltage lets the next charge and rest run, COV/over-voltage lets the next rest and discharge run; below the hard charge floor (2.0 V NMC/LFP) or above max + 0.10 V the test stops and latches
Charge Select (0x6001) cleared and readback-confirmed for rest and discharge steps
Chemistry voltage limits re-applied on crash-recovery resume
Only one cycler window per PC
fixes: Fallback BMS ID includes the COM port and is never saved as the configured ID
Ageing chart: efficiency axis follows full cycles, cycle DCIR from the discharge step, no EOL forecast without fade
dQ/dV readout follows the cursor; no false peak at the live end of the curve
OCV SoC marked under load; current-sensor zero offset reported once per test
V&I chart: compact aligned axes, h:mm time axis, newest-first event strip; elapsed shown as h:mm:ss
Recipe tab: real recipe names, realistic min/cycle estimate, loop fields only on Loop steps
Stop button crimson (was the same amber as Pause); no repeated step numbers; KPI titles name the cell at startup
Manual control follows the hardware readback; export/report defaults no longer relative to the working directory
